pass_conditions_for_future_002c.description: Candidate beats the strongest faithful non-mechanism baseline on heldout and counterfactual partner dynamics.
Full-bundle decoder and serialized-state decoder fail below candidate under fair access.
Pair-count, partner-ID, trace-lookup, finite-state, and belief-table baselines fail below candidate.
Ablated candidate degrades meaningfully under real social-latent update intervention.
Positive-control leakage is detected by callable scanner.
Negative-control no-signal condition blocks false candidate or baseline success.
Replay recomputes candidate and baseline behavior from serialized state plus observation.
All required baselines and ablations are callable and invoked.
Every score records producer function, input artifacts, run ID, seed, context IDs, episode IDs, aggregation rule, and code path hash.
Failure-path tests are present and verify blocked conditions.
No Gate5, admission, bridge, runtime, EGO-mainline, UI, companion, integration, deployment, API key, or external-service files are changed.

automatic_block_conditions: faithful non-oracle baseline ties or beats candidate
negative-control no-signal condition admits false success
social-latent ablation does not degrade candidate behavior
baselines or ablations declared but uninvoked
provenance missing producer function, input artifacts, run ID, seed, context IDs, episode IDs, aggregation rule, or code path hash
candidate receives privileged access unavailable to baselines
claim exceeds bounded offline mechanism-proxy evidence
claim_if_pass: bounded offline mechanism-proxy evidence for the named 002C dynamic partner-belief POMDP experiment only
